# Red Wood Farm

> Garden family restaurant and party lawn on outer Pakhowal Road, Ludhiana, Punjab. Family restaurant first, party lawn second. North Indian, tandoor and Indo-Chinese food, 187 priced dishes, open every day.

## Key facts
- Name: Red Wood Farm
- Address: 676, VPO Daad, Pakhowal Road, Opp. Cerajot Tiles, near Omaxe Flats, Ludhiana, Punjab 142022
- Phone and WhatsApp: 096467 13555 (https://wa.me/919646713555)
- Hours: 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM, every day
- Service: dine-in on a garden lawn with fairy lights, takeaway, Wi-Fi
- Accessibility: no wheelchair access
- Menu: 187 dishes (131 veg), prices in Indian rupees, inclusive of GST; many mains in half and full portions
- Parties: birthday parties, kitty parties, family functions and corporate lunches on the lawn, booked on WhatsApp
- Not published (ask on WhatsApp): guest capacity, per-plate and package prices
- Google rating: 4.2 from 72 reviews (as of 14 Nov 2026)
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=8737420667065992361
